definitions.short: Ben-Oni , the original name of Benjamin
definitions.full: H1126. Ben -oni בֶּןאֿוֺנִ֑י proper name, masculine ( son of my sorrow ) Rachel's name for Benjamin (compare below) Gen 35:18 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1121 and 205 ; son of my sorrow ;

occurrences.englishText: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni,* “Benoni” means “son of my trouble”. but his father named him Benjamin.† “Benjamin” means “son of my right hand”.
